scope: Original base game standard core + applicable linked Living FAQ; optional modules excluded

questions.question: What is the difference between a Growth Move Presence arrow and Add Presence using an island disk? Can the latter pick up a disk outside the shown Range of the destination?

Can Blight cascade into an Ocean on a board with Ocean’s Presence? Can normal Growth Add Presence to that Ocean as if a Coastal Wetland, can it measure from existing Presence there, and how can Ocean put Presence Inland in the base game?

A Ravage adds Blight that reduces Vital Strength of the Earth’s Sacred Site to one Presence. Does losing the site retroactively remove its Defend from the Damage simultaneously dealt to Dahan in that Ravage?

Concealing Shadows has already resolved in Fast, so Dahan in its target land take no Damage from Ravaging Invaders this turn. That land now Ravages with one Town, one Explorer and two healthy Dahan, no Defend and no prior Blight. What happens to land and Dahan, how much counterattack Damage is available, and can it destroy both Invaders for how much Ravage-generated Fear?
